strategy_lineage: prospective shadow of historical F-MARGIN-LEV-US on frozen nfci-dual-core-v11 / dualcore-v11-2026-08-15
hypothesis: The exact historically suggestive but non-robust-certified FINRA margin-leverage rule will show genuine incremental timing value on new post-freeze data without any parameter, availability, sign or portfolio-action changes.
allowed_changes: append-only prospective snapshots using new frozen-V11 forward snapshots and newly published FINRA margin statistics after 2026-08-21
mechanical realized-NAV accounting from already-recorded candidate/matched-control shadow targets under frozen 1.00% fee + 0.05% slippage
operational bug fixes that do not alter factor definition, availability policy, U.S.-de-risk event definition or 50% retention semantics, with old records preserved
selection_metric: No candidate selection. Assess the single frozen candidate independently against contemporaneous frozen V11 and its own availability-matched unconditional U.S.-retention control; 252 sessions is provisional only and 504 sessions is the primary decision.
pass_fail_gates: <63 new sessions: integrity/operations only, no performance conclusion
252 new sessions: provisional observation only; low eligible-event count is INCONCLUSIVE
504 new sessions: append-only/data-causality integrity must pass
504 new sessions: at least 8 factor-available eligible frozen-V11 U.S.-de-risk events
504 new sessions: at least 4 actual candidate interventions
504 new sessions: candidate net annualized return > contemporaneous V11 shadow
504 new sessions: candidate realized Sharpe >= contemporaneous V11 shadow Sharpe
504 new sessions: candidate realized Sharpe > own matched-control Sharpe
gross <=100%, no shorting, no financing and no negative cash throughout
follow_up_policy: Do not tune, replace or reinterpret this candidate using prospective results. A 504-session low-event result is INCONCLUSIVE, not permission to alter the rule. Any future margin-debt hypothesis with another denominator, horizon, sign, threshold, stale rule, publication lag or portfolio action is a new trial with a new freeze date and cannot inherit this prospective label.
swift_engine_entrypoint: Frozen V11 forward snapshot + tools/finra_margin_leverage_v1_logic.swift + dedicated prospective margin shadow CLI/runner; target transformations remain in Swift and snapshots are append-only hash-chained records.
expected_outputs: append-only hash-chained prospective margin snapshot ledger
frozen V11 signal/execution metadata, dataset hash, causal input fingerprint and target fingerprint for every snapshot
FINRA source snapshot SHA plus latest point-in-time-usable reference month, conservative available date, leverage ratio delta and state
candidate and matched-control shadow target weights/fingerprints
U.S.-de-risk/eligible/intervention flags and persistent prior shadow state
realized net NAV/return/Sharpe/MDD summaries at frozen milestones

factor_definition.delta_rule: current reference-month leverage ratio minus immediately previous reference-month leverage ratio
factor_definition.availability_rule: reference month usable only on first calendar day of second following month

portfolio_rule.eligible_event: current V11 event reduces nasdaq and/or sp500 relative to previous frozen V11 event base target and factor state is available
portfolio_rule.candidate_action: when risk-on retain exactly 50% of each nasdaq/sp500 reduction; otherwise use current V11 event target
portfolio_rule.matched_control: on every factor-available eligible event retain exactly 50% of each nasdaq/sp500 reduction

forbidden_changes: changing any frozen V11 rule or target path
changing FINRA leverage denominator or input fields
changing conservative publication lag or 35-day stale rule
factor-driven trades between frozen V11 event dates
adding another candidate to this trial
recomputing, deleting or overwriting an old prospective snapshot after future outcomes are known
using any FINRA observation before its conservative available date
selecting or declaring a winner before the frozen evaluation milestone
